name: Assistance to Voluntary Organisations for Promotion of the Official Languages in the Field of Law
benefit:
- Financial assistance in the form of a grant not exceeding 85% of the anticipated net expenditure involved in the implementation of the project or activity.
- The grants are paid in installments depending on the nature of activities to be undertaken and the progress of the work.

##### ***Conditions***

- _The organisation must bear the balance of the estimated expenditure on the scheme or projec
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a voluntary organisation or institution. - The applicant must propose a project or activity for the development and propagation of literature in the field of law in Hindi or other regional languages. - The applicant must undertake activities such as proposing commentaries, treatises, books, law journals, compendiums, or other relevant publications. - The applicant must agree to bear the balance of the estimated expenditure for the proposed project.
